Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose FIRST item is B. Start at aag: the pair (aag, bad) comes first; its second item is bad. Its first item is bad, so the next pair is the one whose first item is bad: (bad, ddd). Its second item is ddd, but ddd never appears as a first item - so ddd is the dangling end of the chain.

ANSWER: aag, bad, ddd
